method: Static source/control-flow analysis, PE resource extraction and isolated Unicorn emulation of unpacking/decoding. No specimen was launched as a host program; no remote-control endpoint was contacted.

samples.identification: Signed MPRESS wrapper deploying a rebranded RdViewer 6.9.9 client and RdViewer 6.6.8 service
evidence: Original PE claims SelfDev Studio / Disk Manager Tool / Disk Manager Service Installer 6.9.9.0. Its SHA-1 and nested SHA-256 Authenticode content digests match. Cleave verifies signer cryptography. Signer is 黄张兴, issued by Certum Code Signing 2021 CA, valid 2026-10-18 through 2027-10-18. Local osslsigncode lacks the root issuer and fails chain trust, which is not evidence of altered content.

MPRESS entry 0x266e0a9 decompresses the image. The recovered WinMain is 0x401550. 0x401050 counts processor cores; WinMain exits for <=1 core or less than 4000 MiB RAM. These gates precede deployment.

WinMain checks existing Rd_Service/DM_service services and rdservice.exe/rdclient.exe/dmservice.exe/diskmgr.exe processes. The upgrade/cleanup branch stops/deletes the old service, terminates those processes, and clears the target directory. This is not evidence of killing security products.

0x4011b0 implements FindResourceW/LoadResource/LockResource/CreateFileW/WriteFile extraction. 0x40184d onward drops RDSERVICE to C:\ProgramData\host\dmservice.exe, DISKMGR to diskmgr.exe, HOSTDAT to host.dat and CFGINI to cfg.ini.

0x401925 calls CreateServiceW for Rd_Service, display DMService, binary dmservice.exe, SERVICE_WIN32_OWN_PROCESS, automatic start, null account (LocalSystem); 0x40195b starts it. 0x4019e2 launches a CREATE_NO_WINDOW cmd /c ping delay followed by del /f /q of its own path.

DISKMGR is the RdViewer remote administration client: preserved RdViewer/RdClient/uCrypto.pas source attribution, remote screen types, RdViewer UI and vendor update endpoints. Its version identity was changed to Disk Manager. RDSERVICE retains RdViewer service identity. The contents conflict with the claimed storage-management purpose.

Client 0xad62f8 hashes a UTF-16 password with CALG_SHA_256 (0x800c) and derives CALG_AES_128 (0x660e), setting CBC mode. 0xad6640 decrypts Base64 configuration; callers use password 123456. Independently decoding with SHA-256(UTF-16LE(password))[:16], zero-IV AES-CBC recovers host 103.64.13.103:7788, mark 3528427759, Self diskmgr.exe, User admin.

The disguise, preconfigured external remote-access endpoint, automatic privileged service, analysis-sensitive machine gates and installer deletion tip the balance toward abuse. The underlying remote-administration tool has legitimate purposes. Installation authorization, operator ownership, original delivery lure and endpoint ownership are unavailable; no credential theft or observed remote session is asserted.
samples.coverage_gap: Original MPRESS bytes yield only one suspicious packer/API-concealment finding. Decompressed behavior is not matchable in the original facts. Do not manufacture a second independent intent signal from a signature, admin manifest, resource name, or packing metrics. Existing remote-client-storage-utility-disguise fires on the recovered image; the packed original remains below the requested minimum coverage.

samples.identification: Junk-padded VBScript / environment-carried PowerShell registry-staged native loader; externally associated with Remcos
evidence: Extensive comments and unused functions conceal live statements. Concatenating Piscicapturist assignments recovers a 6233-character PowerShell program. Searest takes every fifth character starting at one-based 11 and ending 12 characters before the input end.
A two-second wall-clock busy loop builds a string of closing parentheses; Asc(Mid(Vejr,24223,1))-40 supplies the substring width 1. Skipping/accelerating that loop can break decoding.

Decoded VBS sets process environment Verandaers to PowerShell source and Ungaraged to the quoted PowerShell path. It checks the WOW6432Node ProgramFilesDir registry value to select SysWOW64 or System32 PowerShell. Execute statements set those variables and invoke WScript.Shell.Run with window style 0: cmd.exe /v:on /c echo ^%Verandaers^% | !Ungaraged! - .

The numeric key spells Finmarkens. Cyclic subtraction reveals a Base64 decoder, -bxor expression and character-array join. Base64 plus cyclic XOR with the same key decodes individual script fragments; a variable dot invocation dispatches iex.

Decoded script creates Msxml2.ServerXMLHTTP.6.0, sends synchronous GET with a Firefox User-Agent to https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1P2_ZqhdJBlunqJ2_MLVcpRiD0qzuA4W8, and retries until HKCU:\Vrtplanter\Aserne exists. A successful response is saved in Endangeitis there. Existing registry data can skip the request loop.

The registry value is Base64-decoded and ASCII-converted. Substring(173171,32519) is evaluated. Forager recovered a 274256-byte response, whose decoded 205690-byte body contains the expected PowerShell stage at exactly those offsets. Download and .forage.json provenance are retained in scratch/bad-analysis/gdrive.

The recovered stage defines P/Invoke methods dynamically, hides its console with ShowWindow, rebuilds process environment, resolves NtProtectVirtualMemory, allocates executable memory with VirtualAlloc, copies native code and payload bytes from the downloaded body, then invokes code through CallWindowProcA. This establishes remote native payload execution without identifying the ultimate RAT.

Native loader control flow contains a large junk-fill loop, relocates payload bytes, resolves a memory-protection syscall stub, XORs nested code with 0x81b0e8c2 and calls it. Limited emulation omitted the junk fill and OS call; later native analysis stops on an unresolved memory access. Final Remcos identity, C2 and successful injection are not established.

The doubled-quote SIG comment block decodes to a PKCS#7 certificate issued by and to Lherzolite. A marker and self-issued certificate do not prove a trusted or intact script signature. The existing marker observation is accurate.

Hidden interpreter execution, multilayer concealment, registry-held downloaded code and native execution clearly exceed any evidenced administrative purpose. The external Remcos label is corroborating provenance, not a substitute for payload identification.
samples.coverage: Three accurate suspicious concealment findings remain. Hostile chain mechanics are recovered manually; source splitting and custom decoding prevent current literal matchers from recognizing the full chain.

rule_changes.reason: Clock arithmetic, measuring a sleep, and a wall-clock sleep loop do not establish an anti-analysis objective. Relocate the complete neutral observations rather than suppressing or reducing them.
rule_changes.preservation: Matchers, scopes, confidence and notable criticality are unchanged. Neutral observations no longer inherit anti-analysis ATT&CK/MBC mappings. Both hostile timing composites reference the new homes. Exact and ancestor references were audited; no ancestor selector consumed the moved observations.
rule_changes.controls: Five timing fixtures cover ordinary arithmetic, measurement and waiting, plus both retained hostile consumers. Seven pre-existing vbs-stride-powershell controls from another triage batch also pass.

entropy_correction.unsupported_claim: Header-only PE fallback set code and section entropy to zero although actual .text entropy is 6.47 and .rsrc entropy is 7.96. Four neutral low-entropy claims and their two suspicious consumers were false positives on the extracted client.
entropy_correction.fix: Keep all four trait IDs and criticalities, but measure in-bounds PE section raw bytes with YARA math.entropy. Resource length floors and exceptions remain. The near-zero code claim now explicitly requires all nonempty executable sections to be near-constant, preventing a missing/default aggregate metric or one empty section from declaring real code inert. Code checks explicitly parenthesize executable-section flags and cap measured contents at VirtualSize rather than including file-alignment padding. The existing inert temp-low-host-mimic-dropper fixture retains its required near-zero-code observation.
entropy_correction.consumer_audit: Reviewed direct references to all four traits, including Shark, WannaCry, Elex, GuLoader, StormAttack, resource-loader and tiny-PE consumers, plus prior reasoned-loader-review controls. No consumers were deleted or weakened. The tiny-overlay suppression still requires actual near-zero executable bytes.
entropy_correction.positive_outside_batch: Forager/Hopper recovered hash-verified 077725191c1e6788c47f06264a0dd23cc50eb4e5c0cdea4ec6b06cc086599ab3 from the earlier reasoned-loader review. Its real near-constant resource section remains detected; all four hostile findings (Active Setup, service-DLL replacement, self-delete, StormAttack identity) and its suspicious remote-thread injection finding remain. The downloaded artifact and its .forage.json provenance are retained in scratch/bad-analysis/retained-malware.
entropy_correction.synthetic_controls: Four controls cover low/high actual entropy with both normal headers and deliberately malformed resource directories. The earlier zero-filled and FF-filled resource fixtures retain coverage; high-entropy and small-resource near misses remain negative.

external_reports: Queue-provided Bazaar and Triage pages could not be accessed through browsing. Judgements rely on specimen bytes and the independently fetched referenced Google Drive response.

dm.classifier_disagreement: Both remain benign at the current calibrated thresholds (level -1); manual judgement is MALICIOUS. Do not restore inaccurate placement or duplicate traits to affect the classifier.

extracted_members.original_scan_members: Both original samples are single file reports. MPRESS prevents automatic discovery of the embedded PE resources.
extracted_members.interpretation: Cleave rejects the client resource table (22032896 bytes) and uses header-only fallback. pefile recovers the rewritten Disk Manager version identity. The actual section data is high entropy. Remove the four false zero/low-entropy measurements and the two derived suspicious packing findings; retain the real malformed-header observation, remote-administration capability and all other supported observations. The client certificate is not terminal and osslsigncode ignores it; only the outer wrapper is established as cryptographically intact.
extracted_members.loss_review: Seven finding IDs disappear from the client report: four incorrect entropy properties, two suspicious composites derived from them, and baseline many-imports, which the engine omits after its former consumers stop firing. The import-count rule is unchanged. No accurate attack detection is removed.

validation.focused_controls: Five timing cases and seven pre-existing stride/eval cases passed. Both hostile timing consumers remain detected. No suspicious/hostile findings on the three ordinary timing controls.
validation.final_gate: Final make validate follows all edits. The near-zero-code byte rule requires enabling YARA in the existing inert fixture manifest; its required/forbidden traits and score limits are unchanged. A prior full run also reported an unrelated 4.347ms AST-query timing outlier; the final gate is rerun without weakening that matcher.
validation.entropy_controls: Four raw-entropy controls passed. All 16 case assertions in the earlier reasoned-loader-review harness passed, including zero/FF resource positives and high-entropy/small-resource negatives. That legacy harness then failed its unrelated final hex test because it selects the first pattern in the StormAttack catalog, now a DLL-name string rather than the old call-layout signature. No production rule was changed to satisfy that stale selector. The hash-verified real StormAttack control retains all four hostile and one suspicious attack findings.
